purpose: Derive the eleventh C2 long-tail promotion queue into source-specific deep-read tasks so each swallowing, dental, contact-lens, diabetic-foot, eye-injury, hearing-device, noise-exposure, pediatric-vision, chemosensory, orofacial-pain, vestibular-hypofunction or ototoxicity domain-source pair can later be checked for exact claim use, endpoints, population/setting, uncertainty, transfer boundary, downgrade triggers and model position before any reviewed artifact or model admission.

scope.selectionRule: Derive one queued source-specific extraction task for every candidate source attached to every C2-LT-B11 promotion row.
currentLimitations: This queue derives deep-read tasks; it does not contain completed local review or independent fresh review.
A queued task is not evidence that the cited source supports the domain claim seed.

Candidate URLs require source-context reading and may still need manual access if a practice portal, clinical overview, public-health page, occupational standard, coverage document, scientific article or sensory-health resource blocks automated checks.
No task may be promoted into reviewed Source Cards, variables, endpoints, downgrade checks or calibrated models until exact source-context fields and fresh review are complete.
